Local relationship building · Franklin, Tennessee

Work with Franklin Navigator in the community.

Franklin Navigator is preparing a Community Membership Ambassador role for people who can build genuine relationships with Franklin businesses and organizations in person.

Email my interestSee business membership

What the community work can include

  • Friendly business walk-ins and one-to-one introductions
  • Main Street and local business relationship building
  • Networking and Chamber-style events
  • Fairs, festivals and approved pop-up booths
  • Ribbon cuttings and community gatherings
  • Helping businesses understand Franklin Navigator membership

Current compensation framework

50% of successfully collected commissionable membership revenue for membership months 1–12, then 40% recurring after month 12 while the ambassador agreement remains active and in good standing and the member remains active.

There is no guaranteed income. Compensation depends on successfully collected commissionable membership revenue and the final written ambassador agreement.

How the process works

  1. Send a short interest email.
  2. Franklin Navigator reviews whether the role is a fit.
  3. Roger Gillman makes the final interview and selection decision.
  4. If selected, the formal relationship, responsibilities and classification will be documented before work begins.

This page does not classify the future relationship as employment or independent contracting. That will be determined in the formal arrangement. Franklin Navigator does not guarantee selection, work volume or income.

Routine company messages remain Franklin Navigator-branded; a real person is identified when a human is actually handling the conversation.

Contact today

Email community@franklinnavigator.com. A dedicated local Franklin phone number will appear only after it has been verified and activated; no placeholder number is published.
